headline: Six people cover the top 5 as personas wrap up
subline: P&I team allocation · AI engineers move from personas to modelling
annotation: Reporting is the thinnest skill; AI engineers learn the reporting stack in Q1.
source: Source: planned team of six; personas project closing in the coming weeks.
notes: This is the real team: four AI engineers from the synthetic personas project, one reporting lead from financial health and one data engineer from Level Up.

The persona tool is nearly finished, so the AI engineers move onto the modelling work in the top 5: the noise analysis, pilot uplift, segments, the at-risk model and Brain itself. They are building Brain from day one.
One engineer finishes personas and uses them on Go Big. The thinnest skill is reporting: one person. That is a single point of failure, so the AI engineers learn the reporting stack in Q1.
